pin_globals_to_consts: replace LOAD_GLOBAL and LOAD_DEREF instructions with LOAD_CONST by resolving globals and closure cells to their constant values
reinterpret_const_strings: convert string constants in LOAD_CONST instructions to null-terminated ctypes c_char arrays for BPF compatibility
fold_consts: evaluate binary arithmetic operations and function calls with all-constant operands and replace them with their computed constant results
remove_unread_consts: remove unreferenced LOAD_CONST instructions that have no corresponding source variable references in the instruction list
make_const: create a new LOAD_CONST VarInstruction from an existing instruction, preserving destination variables and setting the constant value
